name: FreeSurfer mri_surf2surf
purpose: Resamples one CorticalSurface onto another, with optional surface smoothing.

inputs.statement: Source subject name in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico; input data must have been sampled onto this subject's surface.
inputs.quote: As found in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico for icosahedron. The input data must have been sampled onto this subject's surface

inputs.statement: File containing the data on the source surface.
inputs.quote: Name of file where the data on the source surface is located.

inputs.statement: Target subject name in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico for icosahedron.
inputs.quote: name of target subject as found in $SUBJECTS_DIR or ico for icosahedron.

conditions.statement: If source and target subjects differ, the registration surface is used; sphere.reg is the default.
conditions.quote: If the source and target subjects are not the same, this surface is used to register the two surfaces. sphere.reg is used as the default.

steps.statement: Specify source subject, source surface values, target subject, target output file, and hemisphere.
steps.quote: mri_surf2surf --srcsubject <source subject name> --srcsurfval <sourcefile> --trgsubject <target suhject name> --trgsurfval <target file> --hemi <hemifield>

steps.statement: Optionally smooth input surface values before resampling.
steps.quote: --smooth-in smoothes the input surface values prior to any resampling.

exceptions.statement: For trg_type w or paint, use the full path for the target file.
exceptions.quote: BUG ALERT: for trg_type w or paint, use the full path.

exceptions.statement: With paint output, specify the output file with a partial path or it will be written into the subject's anatomical directory.
exceptions.quote: When the output format is paint, the output file must be specified with a partial path (eg, ./data-lh.w) or else the output will be written into the subject's anatomical directory.

outputs.statement: File where the data on the target surface will be stored.
outputs.quote: Name of file where the data on the target surface will be stored.

parameters.statement: Mapping method: nnfr (nearest-neighbor, forward and reverse, default) or nnf (forward only).
parameters.quote: Legal values are: nnfr (neighest-neighbor, forward and reverse) and nnf (neighest-neighbor, forward only). Default is nnfr.

parameters.statement: Icosahedron order n, with #vertices=10*4^n+2; largest available generally best.
parameters.quote: This specifies the size of the icosahedron according to the formula #vertices=10*4^n+2. In general, it is best to use the largest size available.

parameters.statement: Each smoothing iteration averages each vertex with its neighbors.
parameters.quote: Each iteration consists of averaging eeach vertex with its neighbors.

parameters.statement: Frame number for paint/w output, zero-based, default 0.
parameters.quote:
--frame <framenumber>

When using paint/w output format, this specifies which frame to output. This format can store only one frame. The frame number is zero-based (default is 0).
